data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 深夜下线之后
data.description: 深夜房间，她摘下 AmuSphere 头显，蓝光的余韵还留在视网膜上；望向书桌上现实的眼镜，两个自己和平共处的瞬间——她已经不再害怕了。
data.action: 深夜房间，她摘下 AmuSphere 头显，蓝光的余韵还留在视网膜上
data.promptProse: Late at night, Shino Asada lifts off her AmuSphere and looks toward the ordinary glasses resting on her desk. Her soft blue sweater and grey lounge trousers belong to her real-world appearance, with ash-brown hair and thoughtful brown eyes. The medium view places the headset in her hands above the chair arm, desk and monitor behind. Monitor light colors the device rim and her nearer cheek, leaving the wall beyond the desk subdued.
